about: Christopher Wright is an attorney who represents clients in the Seattle, Washington area. Christopher Wright is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2011 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Christopher Wright chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended University of Washington School of Law and graduated in 1996. Christopher Wright passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1996.
He represents clients with Construction Litigation: Business issues in Washington. He also represents clients with General Litigation issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Christopher Wright has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
